headline: GSK Acquires RAPT Therapeutics for $2.2 Billion to Boost Immunology Pipeline
body: British pharmaceutical giant GSK has agreed to acquire U.S.-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company RAPT Therapeutics for approximately $2.2 billion in an all-cash transaction. The deal, structured as a tender offer followed by a second-step merger, is expected to close in the first quarter of 2026. GSK aims to strengthen its immunology portfolio with RAPT's promising food allergy treatment, positioning the company to capitalize on the growing market for allergy therapies. The acquisition represents a strategic move to diversify GSK's pipeline and leverage RAPT's innovative research capabilities.

headline: Hims & Hers Health to Acquire Eucalyptus for Up to $1.15 Billion, Accelerating Global Expansion
body: Hims & Hers Health announced Thursday it will acquire Australian digital health company Eucalyptus in a deal valued at up to $1.15 billion, as the U.S. telehealth firm pushes into international markets to expand its personalized-care business. The acquisition will accelerate Hims & Hers' vision to become the leading global consumer health platform, giving it immediate access to Eucalyptus' established presence in Australia and New Zealand. This strategic move positions the company to compete more effectively in the rapidly growing digital health market while diversifying its revenue streams beyond the U.S.

headline: Nuveen to Acquire Schroders for $13.5 Billion, Creating $2.5 Trillion Asset Management Giant
body: Chicago-based Nuveen has agreed to buy London-listed asset manager Schroders in a $13.5 billion deal that will create one of the world's largest asset management firms with $2.5 trillion in assets under management. The acquisition values Schroders at 16.5 times 2026 earnings and ends two centuries of family ownership of the historic British firm. The merger will combine Nuveen's strength in U.S. retirement markets with Schroders' global investment expertise, creating significant cost synergies and expanded product offerings for clients across 40 global markets.

headline: Getty Images-Shutterstock Merger Faces Regulatory Setback in UK Over Editorial Content Concerns
body: The $3.7 billion merger between Getty Images and Shutterstock faces a regulatory setback in the U.K. after the competition regulator found concerns about reduced competition in the editorial content market. While the deal was cleared in the global stock content market, the UK's Competition and Markets Authority identified potential issues with the combined company's dominance in editorial photography and news imagery. The merger, announced in 2025, would create the world's largest visual content provider, combining Getty's premium editorial content with Shutterstock's broader creative assets.

headline: DoorDash Shares Rise 14% After Earnings Miss as Investors Focus on Long-Term Growth Strategy
body: DoorDash shares surged 14% Friday despite the company reporting fourth-quarter earnings and revenue that missed analyst expectations. The food delivery giant forecast adjusted EBITDA between $675 million and $775 million for the first quarter, below StreetAccount estimates of $802 million. However, investors focused on DoorDash's strategic acquisition of Deliveroo and management's outlook for improved full-year 2026 EBITDA margins. The company's expansion into international markets and continued dominance in U.S. food delivery position it for long-term growth despite near-term headwinds.

headline: Equinox Gold Declares Inaugural Dividend After Transformational Year with Record Production
body: Equinox Gold announced an inaugural quarterly cash dividend of $0.015 per share and applied for a normal course issuer bid to repurchase approximately 5% of its outstanding shares. The gold mining company reported a transformational 2025 with strategic mergers, record production of 778,561 ounces, and more than $1.1 billion in debt reduction. The dividend announcement, targeting a regular quarterly payment of $0.015 per share ($0.06 annually), signals management's confidence in the company's strong cash flow generation and improved balance sheet position following its debt reduction efforts.
